-- 计算器（内置示例小应用）
-- 键盘按九宫格排布：4 列 × 5 行。左右键在行内移动，长按左右键上下换行，语音键确认
-- 可用 API：ui.title/text/center/rect/footer/clear/size/measure/content_top/
--           line_height、store.get/set, sys.exit

local W, H = ui.size()
local TOP = ui.content_top()   -- 正文起始 y（状态栏下方）
local LH = ui.line_height()
local COLS, ROWS = 4, 5
local GAP = 10
local CELL_H = 104
local CELL_W = math.floor((W - 24 - GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS)
local GRID_X = math.floor((W - (CELL_W * COLS + GAP * (COLS - 1))) / 2)
local GRID_Y = TOP + 128
local CHAR = (utf8 and utf8.charpattern) or "."

-- 行优先排列，和屏幕上的九宫格一一对应
local buttons = {
  "C", "(", ")", "←",
  "7", "8", "9", "/",
  "4", "5", "6", "*",
  "1", "2", "3", "-",
  "0", ".", "=", "+",
}
local sel = 1
local expr = ""
local result = ""

-- 表达式太长时保留末尾（刚输入的 digits 才是用户关心的），前面用省略号
local function tail_fit(text, width)
  if ui.measure(text) <= width then return text end
  local chars = {}
  for ch in text:gmatch(CHAR) do chars[#chars + 1] = ch end
  local out = ""
  for i = #chars, 1, -1 do
    local candidate = chars[i] .. out
    if ui.measure("…" .. candidate) > width then break end
    out = candidate
  end
  return "…" .. out
end

local function number_text(value)
  if value == math.floor(value) and math.abs(value) < 1e15 then
    return string.format("%d", value)
  end
  return string.format("%.8g", value)
end

-- 四则运算 + 括号 + 小数：递归下降，格式不对返回 nil
local function evaluate(text)
  local pos = 1
  local length = #text
  local function peek() return text:sub(pos, pos) end

  local function parse_number()
    local start = pos
    local seen = false
    while pos <= length do
      local ch = peek()
      if ch:match("[%d]") then
        seen = true
        pos = pos + 1
      elseif ch == "." and not seen then
        pos = pos + 1
      else
        break
      end
    end
    return tonumber(text:sub(start, pos - 1))
  end

  local parse_expr, parse_term, parse_factor

  parse_factor = function()
    local ch = peek()
    if ch == "-" then
      pos = pos + 1
      local value = parse_factor()
      if value == nil then return nil end
      return -value
    elseif ch == "+" then
      pos = pos + 1
      return parse_factor()
    elseif ch == "(" then
      pos = pos + 1
      local value = parse_expr()
      if value == nil or peek() ~= ")" then return nil end
      pos = pos + 1
      return value
    end
    return parse_number()
  end

  parse_term = function()
    local value = parse_factor()
    if value == nil then return nil end
    while true do
      local ch = peek()
      if ch == "*" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local right = parse_factor()
        if right == nil then return nil end
        value = value * right
      elseif ch == "/" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local right = parse_factor()
        if right == nil or right == 0 then return nil end
        value = value / right
      else
        return value
      end
    end
  end

  parse_expr = function()
    local value = parse_term()
    if value == nil then return nil end
    while true do
      local ch = peek()
      if ch == "+" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local right = parse_term()
        if right == nil then return nil end
        value = value + right
      elseif ch == "-" then
        pos = pos + 1
        local right = parse_term()
        if right == nil then return nil end
        value = value - right
      else
        return value
      end
    end
  end

  local value = parse_expr()
  if value == nil or pos <= length then return nil end
  return value
end

local function press(label)
  if label == "C" then
    expr = ""
    result = ""
  elseif label == "←" then
    expr = expr:sub(1, #expr - 1)
    result = ""
  elseif label == "=" then
    if expr == "" then return end
    local value = evaluate(expr)
    if value == nil then
      result = "表达式有误"
    else
      result = "= " .. number_text(value)
      expr = number_text(value)
    end
  else
    if #expr >= 40 then return end
    expr = expr .. label
    result = ""
  end
end

function draw()
  ui.clear()
  ui.title("计算器")
  ui.text(tail_fit(expr == "" and "0" or expr, W - 32), 16, TOP + 38, W - 32)
  if result ~= "" then ui.text(result, 16, TOP + 38 + LH, W - 32) end

  for i, label in ipairs(buttons) do
    local col = (i - 1) % COLS
    local row = math.floor((i - 1) / COLS)
    local x = GRID_X + col * (CELL_W + GAP)
    local y = GRID_Y + row * (CELL_H + GAP)
    ui.rect(x, y, CELL_W, CELL_H, false)
    if i == sel then
      -- 选中格用双层描边强调（墨水屏无法反白，实心填充会吞掉文字）
      ui.rect(x + 2, y + 2, CELL_W - 4, CELL_H - 4, false)
      ui.rect(x + 4, y + 4, CELL_W - 8, CELL_H - 8, false)
    end
    local tw = ui.measure(label)
    ui.text(label, x + math.floor((CELL_W - tw) / 2),
            y + math.floor((CELL_H - LH) / 2), CELL_W)
  end
  ui.footer("左右选择 · 上下长按换行 · 语音确认 · 电源退出")
end

function on_key(action)
  local col = (sel - 1) % COLS
  local row = math.floor((sel - 1) / COLS)
  if action == "prev" then
    sel = row * COLS + (col - 1) % COLS + 1
  elseif action == "next" then
    sel = row * COLS + (col + 1) % COLS + 1
  elseif action == "prev_long" then
    sel = ((row - 1) % ROWS) * COLS + col + 1
  elseif action == "next_long" then
    sel = ((row + 1) % ROWS) * COLS + col + 1
  elseif action == "ok" then
    press(buttons[sel])
  elseif action == "back" then
    sys.exit()
  end
end
